latest_release.name: pre-ai
latest_release.body:
I've taken the decision to allow AI tool use in PRs. I can't guarantee that every person before this point made their modifications without the use of AI, but I can guarantee that I did not use AI for any commit from this point or before.

I know AI use is a real thorny issue for people, so I wanted to give y'all an opt-out to use a known blessed older version of the library if you so choose.
